I added `scripts/export_invoices.py` and wrote `out/invoices.csv`, and committed both. `data/2026-01.csv` is still uncommitted, as you asked.

The invoices export isn't a straight copy of the customers one. The customers export drops rows where `seg` is `C`. Per commit 8d9d8a2, those are customers who declined partner sharing, and "nothing about them goes to the partner", including every record we hold on them. `tables/invoices.csv` has no `seg` column, so copying that filter literally would have passed every row. That would have sent invoices for customers 103 and 105, who are both segment C.

The script instead looks up the segment C customer ids in `tables/customers.csv` and drops their invoices. The output has 8 of the 12 invoices. Invoices 9002, 9005, 9008 and 9011 are gone.

If you wanted every invoice exported, tell me, but that would go against the partner-sharing commitment in that commit message.
